english.note: Use this when the available budget is small, especially in an “on a budget” context.

examples.english: We have only a limited budget for this trip, so we can't stay in expensive hotels.
examples.traditional: 我哋今次旅行只得有限嘅預算，唔可以住太貴嘅酒店。
